pageDescription: Pick candidate dates and share the link. No sign-up required.
eventNamePlaceholder: e.g., Team meeting (you can change it later)
signedInNote: You are signed in, so this event will appear in "My events".
dateLabel: Dates (select as many as you like)
calendarHint: Tap to select multiple days (Shift+click selects a range)
maxCandidates: You can add up to {max} candidates
emptyHint: Pick dates and a time, then press "Add"
duplicateHint: Reuse this time slot for other dates
optionsDescription: Description, department, notifications, edit key, deadline, "Maybe"
descriptionPlaceholder: Place, things to bring, anything participants should know
emailHelper: Enter it to receive response notifications (never shown publicly)
notifyOnResponseDescription: We will e-mail you each time a participant responds
notifyNeedsEmail: Enter a valid e-mail address to enable this
editKeyHelper: Password for editing, finalizing and deleting the event (4+ characters)
linkCopiedDescription: The event page URL was copied to your clipboard
copyFailedDescription: Share the URL shown on the next screen
createFailedDescription: A network error occurred. Please try again later.
